newsitem.title: USA: Farrel workers on strike in Connecticut.
newsitem.headline: Farrel workers on strike in Connecticut.

text.p: Forty-six unionized workers at Farrel Corp.'s assembly, repair and warehouse facilities in two Connecticut locations went on strike Wednesday, the rubber and plastics equipment company said.
The striking workers make up about 22 percent of the work force in Ansonia and Derby, Conn., a spokesman at the Ansonia, Conn.-based company said.

The company, which makes equipment to process rubber and plastics, said it expected to meet its obligations to customers despite the strike but could not forecast the effect the walkout might have on its financial results.

Farrel and Local 3571 of the United Steelworkers of America have not agreed on the terms of a contract replacing a pact that expired Monday, the company said, adding negotiations will continue during the strike.
Farrel's stock fell 12.5 cents to $3.125 on Nasdaq.
